newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cenbank raises 6-mo deposit rate.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank raises 6-mo deposit rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said it raised the six-month rate at which it accepts deposits from commercial banks to 21.00 percent from 20.75 percent.
The central bank left its repo rates unchanged.
Repo cut expectations on the Hungarian markets had prevailed before the NBH rate hike despite what NBH President Gyorgy Suranyi said on Friday about need to protect savings.
Suranyi said that the central bank was determined to keep market interest rates close to current levels so as to maintain attractive real interest rates on savings.
The NBH changes its repo rates usually on Monday at around 1300 GMT.
